snippet.title: Cast n Chill (Cozy Fishing) - Steam Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Play the Cast n Chill demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3483740?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demotrailer

Cast n Chill is a cozy idle fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - with your loyal pup by your side.
